soldier: Head orange-yellow, thorax and abdomen pale yellow, pilosity of the body sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.60–0.64, lateral margins parallel, frontal region flat. Labrum lanceolate, about 1.02–1.23 times as long as wide, the semi-transparent area at the apex narrow and rounded, apical and lateral apical setae well developed, subapical setae and labral ridge setae present or reduced. Mandibles about 0.52–0.56 times head capsule length and 0.84–0.89 times head width, apex slightly curved, the middle section rather stout; a minute tooth lies below the basal notch of each mandible, and the basal ridge on the outer margin is indistinct. About 8 setae along the margin of the lacinia. Narrow region of the postmentum slightly broad, waist constriction index 0.30–0.34. Pronotum about 1.45 times as wide as long, the incisions of the anterior and posterior margins both rather deep, median emargination index 15–21%; about 30 setae in the middle region.
